evidence.r1: The Up next track list and its artwork sit on a large glass content panel.
evidence.r2: The playlist menu is a glass popover drawn directly over the glass queue panel.
evidence.r3: Transport, volume, queue and its contextual menu form a small set with clear playback roles.
evidence.r4: Transport, queue and playlist menu share the same cloudy light regular-glass treatment.
evidence.r5: No clear-glass variant is visible; the ice artwork is heavily diffused within the controls.
evidence.r6: The scrubber is the only visibly coloured control, with red confined to its progress track rather than a label.
evidence.r7: The normal transport and queue show diffused ice texture and become flat light surfaces in the reduced capture.
evidence.r8: Transport, volume and queue have fixed rounded corners, while the pause feedback shape is circular.
evidence.r9: The nearly edge-to-edge selected playlist row has corners that do not follow the outer menu arcs.
evidence.r10: The compact playlist entries are rounded rectangles and the playback buttons use compact circular shapes.
evidence.r11: Transport items share one bar, volume occupies another and playlist actions belong to the queue.
evidence.r12: The transport contains icon buttons and track information rather than text buttons; Playlists is separate in the queue.
evidence.r13: The material covers the complete transport and volume controls, leaving their labels and sliders unglazed.
evidence.r14: The nearby queue and playlist menu read as two superimposed glass materials rather than one container.
evidence.r15: No captured content scrolls beneath the fixed transport, and no gratuitous scroll-edge effect is drawn.
evidence.r16: The intricate ice image provides varied content behind transport, volume and queue.
evidence.r17: The opened playlist menu covers queue artwork and track labels in its resting state.
evidence.r18: The light transport text is legible, but no dark-state capture verifies the required contrast in both modes.
evidence.r19: The reduced-transparency transport and queue remain usable, but increased contrast and reduced motion are not shown.
evidence.r20: The album artwork reaches all four edges behind the floating transport and queue.
evidence.r21: Album text starts below the transport and stays left of the queue while the artwork extends continuously behind both.
evidence.r22: The transport and queue show material rims without an extra distinct backing panel.
evidence.r23: The playlist-menu still cannot establish opening morphs or pointer-local press feedback.
evidence.r24: The transport scrubber carries a saturated red progress line in the control layer.
evidence.r25: Dark transport and queue labels remain distinct from the pale blue-white ice-derived glass.
